g.text: All 24 contrasts: individual paired schedule-block differences
Original primary cohort only: 896 attempts; 890 valid graphs; 6 terminal failures.
Each dot is one complete schedule block: four-model mean minus its same-seed US-English baseline.
Vertical jitter follows seed order. Incomplete blocks omitted, never zero-filled. Dots show sign variability, not independent models.
